args.title: Fix incorrect npm script name in README's Running locally section
args.body:
File: README.md

In the "Running locally" section, step 5 tells users to run `npm run serve`, but package.json only defines `start`, `build`, `test`, and `lint` scripts (no `serve`). Replace `npm run serve` with `npm start` so the instructions match the actual script that runs `node dist/index.js`.

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The README's "Running locally" section tells users to run `npm run serve`, but package.json only defines `start`, `build`, `test`, and `lint` scripts—there is no `serve` script. The instructions should reference `npm start` instead.
